operationalInput.goalSource: the exact comparisonGoal.formalClaim from the accepted corpus record
operationalInput.caseSelection: fixed corpus order; no role, label, expectation, oracle, or validation term is passed to the operational process
operationalInput.fixture: one selected case source module plus the shared Pitfalls source/module; all other case, aggregate, and validation modules are omitted from the temporary repository and Lean library path
operationalInput.freshness: selected source and compiled artifacts must match both the accepted corpus and frozen source-artifact inventory

automaticRoute.operation: source-goal capture followed by exact goal completion
automaticRoute.tacticScript: by first | assumption | rfl | simp | omega
automaticRoute.interpretation: a replayed proof of P establishes an inhabited formal claim; a replayed proof of not P establishes its inconsistency. Capture failure, no proof, rejected proof, or replay/resource failure is unresolved. This does not by itself establish a source error.

limits.preparation: included in the per-case elapsed-time receipt

isolationChecks.excludedImports: all other corpus case modules plus CoreCases and Validation must fail with the exact requested-module-unavailable diagnostic
isolationChecks.unrelatedFailure: must not be accepted as evidence of isolation
isolationChecks.forbiddenModuleInjection: a deliberately copied forbidden compiled module must make the isolation guard fail

nonclaims: This protocol does not parse natural-language prose or certify prose/formal fidelity.
A rejected candidate or failed tactic is not evidence that a proposition is false.
A checked positive or negative proposition does not by itself determine whether a premise is intentional or an exposition error.
The import guard is not an operating-system filesystem sandbox.
